description:
pi-mono's parseStreamingJson returns whatever JSON.parse yields (arrays, primitives, fallback {}); ours returns only maps, silently coercing everything else to %{}. Benign for Anthropic today (tool args are always objects) but it's an implicit contract divergence not called out anywhere.

Decision: keep the map-only contract (simpler, type-safe, Anthropic tool-args ARE always objects). Pin the deviation explicitly:

TDD:
- RED: write a regression test \`test \"pi-mono would return the array; we coerce to %{}\"\` asserting parse_streaming(\"[1,2,3]\") == %{} with a comment citing the TS line and this ticket ID.
- GREEN: verify the test passes with current impl.
- REFACTOR: update partial_json.ex moduledoc to state the deviation + update docs/port-map/anthropic.md §4.2 (currently implies parity, but we diverge).

Files: partial_json.ex, partial_json_test.exs, docs/port-map/anthropic.md.
title: parse_streaming: document map-only contract deviation from pi-mono
